tagline: FINANCE & ADMINISTRATION LEADERSHIP  ·  BUDGET ACCOUNTABILITY  ·  MULTI-ENTITY REPORTING  ·  SCALABLE PROCESSES
profile: Finance and administration executive who builds documented, scalable finance functions for membership and mission-driven organizations. Leads the annual budget process and holds leaders accountable to approved budgets; directs month-end close, cash-flow forecasting, audits, tax and regulatory filings, and internal controls; and reports clearly to executives and Boards. Brings multi-entity financial leadership, ERP implementation (60% efficiency gain), and oversight of payroll, banking, HR, and outsourced providers. Reversed a $1M operating deficit into a 13% surplus and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis.

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Provide hands-on leadership in multi-entity finance, public funding, capital strategy, and audit remediation.
Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
